description: The plot illustrates an accuracy comparison between two experiments (Ex1 and Ex2) during an Embedding and LM Head training stage by showing next-token prediction accuracy as training progresses. The x-axis is labeled “Step,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 60,000 with regularly spaced tick labels every 10,000 steps. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Next Token Prediction),” uses a linear scale, and shows values roughly from 0.10 up to just above 0.40, with labeled ticks at 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30, 0.35, and 0.40 (a 0.05 interval). Two solid lines with circular markers are shown: the Ex1 Accuracy line is blue and rises from about 0.09 at step 0 to about 0.24 near 2,000 steps, then increases to around 0.39 near 8,000 steps and gradually levels off, reaching approximately 0.40–0.41 from about 14,000 steps through the final plotted steps near 60,000. The Ex2 Accuracy line is teal and increases from about 0.09 at step 0 to about 0.27 near 2,000 steps, then climbs more gradually to around 0.28–0.29 by roughly 8,000–14,000 steps, rises to about 0.36 near 19,000 steps, and continues increasing slowly, ending near about 0.39 by the last plotted steps close to 60,000.
